meta.name: add-mnemon
meta.description: Add persistent graph-based memory via mnemon. Agents recall past context before responding and remember insights after each turn.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让智能体记住每次对话的上下文和洞察
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想让智能体在多次对话中保持记忆
copy.tagline_en: Enable agents to remember context and insights across conversations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your agent to retain memory across turns

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会在每次回复前自动调取与该对话相关的历史记忆,并在回合结束后把新见解写入持久记忆库;记忆跨容器重启保留,后续会话可以继续引用。
howto.when: 在 Claude Code 环境下,每个对话回合开始前和结束后自动触发,无需用户手动指令;安装时已通过 mnemon setup 注册好挂钩。

say.text: 你还记得我们上周讨论的数据库选型吗?
say.note: Claude 会从持久记忆中调取相关上下文。

say.text: 根据以往项目记录,我偏好 Python 还是 Go?
say.note: 它会检索存储的偏好并回答。

say.text: 把这次的结论存进记忆,下次继续用。
say.note: 回合结束后新信息会被写入记忆库。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude automatically retrieves relevant historical memory before each response and stores new insights after each turn. Memory persists across container restarts and can be referenced in later sessions.
howto.when_en: Automatically triggered before and after each conversation turn in the Claude Code environment; no manual user command needed. Hooks are registered by 'mnemon setup' during installation.

say_en.text: Do you remember the database choice we discussed last week?
say_en.note: Claude pulls relevant context from persistent memory.

say_en.text: Based on past projects, do I prefer Python or Go?
say_en.note: It retrieves stored preferences and answers.

say_en.text: Save this conclusion to memory for the next session.
say_en.note: New insights are stored after the turn.
